anomalies.description: A silver minivan on the right side of the road begins to pull out or swerve into the lane of the dashcam vehicle, creating an imminent collision risk; the minivan's front wheels are turned sharply left and it is partially in the travel lane at f14 (7.0s) and fully encroaching by f15 (7.5s).; A silver minivan is seen crossing the centerline and colliding with the camera vehicle; the impact occurs between frames f0 and f1, as evidenced by the sudden violent motion and subsequent view of the sky/ceiling.

A white semi-trailer truck on the right side of the road loses control, jackknifes, and overturns onto the shoulder, kicking up a large cloud of dust. The trailer separates from the cab and slides sideways across the dirt shoulder.; The overturned white trailer continues sliding and comes to rest on its side on the right shoulder, with dust settling. A second white trailer (possibly the same vehicle’s rearmost section or a separate vehicle) is also seen overturned further ahead and to the left, indicating a multi-vehicle incident or trailer separation.
A black sedan (with yellow markings, possibly a taxi) collides with a silver sedan at the intersection while turning left; the impact causes visible deformation and displacement of both vehicles.
